title: S.T.F.U - Skyrim Talk Filter Utility
tagline: Skyrim Talk Filter Utility silences tedious frequent utterances
description:
Skyrim Talk Filter Utility gives you full control over what dialogue you hear in game. Stop repetitive NPC chatter for polluting SkyrimNet's context or interrupting conversations.

## Features
- **Intuitive UI** for viewing all dialogue that plays in game. Block whatever you want instantly.
- **Soft Blocking**: block audio/subtitles from certain dialogue to essentially block it without preventing important scripts from executing. Soft blocked dialogue does not get logged by SkyrimNet *(recommended)*
- **Hard Blocking**: block dialogue from playing at all. Useful for scenes with packages you want to prevent. Can potentially block scripts, use carefully.
- **Subtype Filtering**: block all dialogue belonging to certain subtypes for broad dialogue blocking.
- **Whitelist**: prevent certain dialogue from being blocked under any circumstances to create rule exceptions.\n- **Actor & Faction Filtering**: When blacklisting or whitelisting you can create rules for specific actors or factions.
- **Persistent & Immediate**: Your blacklist and whitelist is stored in an external database that persists between saves. Changes take place immediately, no need to restart.

- **Lite Mode**: If you can't use the PrismaUI menu (or don't want to) you can block dialogue by viewing the STFU_DialogueLog.txt file and adding the topics to the YAMLs. Click \"Import from YAML\" in the MCM to import the entries into the database. See the github page for more details.

## Requirements
- SkyUI (for MCM)
- PrismaUI (for UI)
- SKSE
- Address Library
- powerofthree's Tweaks
author: zevick
changelog:
## Before you update
- **New requirement:** [powerofthree's Tweaks](https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/51073) replaces Native EditorID Fix.
- **41 scenes were removed from the pre-included list** because blocking them could potentially break quests or strand NPCs. Existing installs keep them until you delete them from the Blacklist tab, or clear your scene blacklist and re-import.

S.T.F.U has been updated to the latest version of commonlibsse-NG. It should work on all versions, but 1.7.X is untested.
## Fixes
- Blacklist and whitelist entries now keep working after load-order changes.
- Actor filters no longer mix up NPCs with the same name.
- Each scene toggle (ambient, follower commentary, bard songs, blacklist) now controls its own scenes.
- Removed pre-included scenes stay removed instead of being re-imported every launch.
- If a game update moves the subtitle/response code, STFU skips those hooks and logs an error instead of crashing.
- Freeze/crash shortly after loading a save.
- VR crash during dialogue with the STFU menu open.
- Jarl Laila and Anuriel getting stuck in Mistveil Keep.
- Your own hard-blocked scenes playing when "Block Ambient Scenes" was off.
- Scene blocks intermittently failing on AE.
- Some entries added from History never matching.
- Editing a blacklist entry erasing its faction filters.
- Editing a whitelist entry adding a bogus "actorFilterFormIDs" actor (remove that chip if you see it).
- "Block Follower Commentary" checkbox showing the opposite state.
- Empty recent-actors list in the edit window.
- Notes and names with quotes or line breaks being cut off.
- YAML FormKeys not working for ESL plugins.
- Repeated follower lines now show up again in History, and only the chosen reply to a follower command is logged.
